data_fields.name: memory_tail_cap_bytes
data_fields.donor_constant: set by caller (not read in this file)

data_fields.name: pending_queue_max
data_fields.donor_constant: none (unbounded channel in donor); proposed bound in sketch

best_idea: Keep one serialized writer per zone, cap in-memory history by bytes, and attach live followers by taking the subscription before the snapshot, so an admin view sees every line once without a gap.
decision_why: Keep the serial writer, byte-capped tail, forward-only daily rotation, panic-only backtraces and snapshot-then-follow handoff. Bound the pending queue and count refusals instead of an unbounded channel, and never throw from the write path. The log is a write-only sink, so one ledger and server-verified kills are untouched. The licence is BSL 1.1, so this is clean-room: shape only.
acceptance: A server test writes 10,000 records with maxBytes 65536 and asserts resident bytes stay at or under 65536, tail(200) returns the last 200 lines, and a follower attached before a write receives that write exactly once; a second test makes the sink throw and asserts the tick does not throw and sinkErrors counts the lines.
